description: In this semiabstract landscape, large green trees stretch in front of a deep blue lake. Alongside these trees is a bright white birch tree with yellow leaves. Beyond the lake, purple mountains rise beneath a blue sky filled with rippling clouds.
title: Lake George with White Birch
